title: Public Alert No. 030/2026: Alert on the Withdrawal of Levamisole-Containing Medicines as endorsed by the Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA) over serious Neurological risks
summary: NAFDAC relays the Italian Medicines Agency's endorsement of an EU-wide withdrawal of all levamisole-containing medicines, after EMA's PRAC found the anthelmintic's benefits no longer outweigh risks due to rare but serious leukoencephalopathy (brain white matter damage).
